q: LeetCode 判题系统的核心功能需求包括哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which core functional requirements should a LeetCode-style judging system support? (Select all that apply)

提交后能返回判题结果

Let users write and run code in multiple languages.

whenOtherWins: 如果安全隔离要求极高且能接受额外成本，VM 会比普通容器更稳妥。
